name: Rootkit
summary: Adversaries may deploy rootkits to hide the presence of programs, files, network connections, services, drivers, and other system components. Rootkits are programs that hide the existence of malware by intercepting and modifying operating-system API calls that supply system information. analytics.name: Analytic 1912
analytics.guidance: Periodic or event-triggered integrity verification identifies a discrepancy between a field device's self-reported diagnostic state and an independently verified hardware/firmware fingerprint, indicating the device's reporting layer has been compromised. MITRE explicitly notes firmware/module rootkits 'can also be developed for the Input/Output (I/O) that is attached to an asset.'. analytics.name: Analytic 2146
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies inconsistencies between auditd-recorded process activity and what /proc reports, or kernel module loads from non-standard paths on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux assets. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2167
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) host telemetry gaps -- process lists differing between Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) and direct enumeration, or unexpected kernel driver loads from unexpected paths -- suggesting kernel-level manipulation of what the Operating System (OS) reports. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2185
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) network device telemetry gaps -- Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) polling returning inconsistent results, syslog sequence gaps -- suggesting kernel-level manipulation of device-reported state. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
